name: HackHarvard
venue: Student Organization Center at Hilles, Harvard University
participants_note: 528 registered on Devpost; free to attend.

prizes.name: Aramco Power the Future Track Prize
prizes.reward: Water bottle and gift card per member
prizes.notes: Energy, infrastructure, transportation and logistics. Teams choose one track each.

prizes.name: Visa Truth and Trust Track Prize
prizes.notes: Integrity against deepfakes, misinformation and fraud. Teams choose one track each.

prizes.name: Infosys Human Augmentation Track Prize
prizes.notes: Accessibility, AR/VR and neurotech that expand human ability.

prizes.name: Living Culture Track Prize
prizes.notes: Art, storytelling, music, fashion and architecture.

prizes.name: Best AI Application Built with Cloudflare
Best Domain Name from GoDaddy Registry
Best Financial Hack by Capital One
Telora Startup Challenge
prizes.reward: Interviews for up to three teams
prizes.notes: No winning project page names this prize.

prizes.name: Best First-Time Hack
prizes.notes: More than half the team must be first-time attendees.

prize_count_note: 18 non-cash prizes; no cash total published.

criteria.label: Innovation, Creativity and Impact
criteria.description: How new the idea is and how effective it would be in the real world.

criteria.label: Technical Complexity
criteria.description: Technical knowledge and advanced techniques used effectively.

criteria.label: Functionality and Usability
criteria.description: Ease of use, smooth running and an intuitive user journey.

criteria.label: Collaboration and Learning
criteria.description: Fair contribution from every member; for solo projects, what was explored and learned.

judging.judge_profile_summary: One judge is named on the Devpost page.
judging.notes: Teams select one track and any number of sponsor challenges. Hacker rules are on the organizer's own site, not Devpost.

curator_notes: All 18 prize winners are analyzed records. The overall top three are ranked. The Devpost rules page does not state a team size, so team_size is null. The Telora Startup Challenge has no winning project page. Taglines are CrafterWIKI paraphrases; domains assigned conservatively.
